from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """One judgment document with its title and case cause category for filtering."""
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The document's title/label as given in the collection")
    case_cause: str | None = Field(description="The case cause category (案由) as identified in the document, e.g., '国家赔偿', '行政许可', '工伤认定'")
    is_administrative_licensing: bool | None = Field(description="Whether this document's case cause falls under '行政行为 - 行政许可'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
